events.event_name: Scoop the City Ice Cream Truck Tour
events.address: Multiple NYC stops; see dated occurrence details
events.what_it_is: A two-day roaming ice cream truck tour from Piece of Cake Moving and StreetEasy highlighting their 2026 NYC neighborhoods-to-watch list.
events.what_is_free: Free ice cream treats are advertised at each stop. Visitors can also enter giveaways for Knicks tickets, restaurant gift cards, MTA passes, merchandise and other prizes; giveaway wins are not guaranteed.
events.caveats: This is a moving truck activation with short, location-specific windows. Free treats and promotional inventory are subject to availability, and sweepstakes prizes are chance-based.
